main.description: P16 step 6 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Auto-rigs the reconstructed mesh on the VKE CPU pool, two tracks inside one pod image `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/blender-rigify-rignet:0.1`: (a) Blender Rigify template-fit (anime-tuned meta-rig auto-scaled to the mesh AABB + head landmark) — production primary; (b) in-house RigNet distill checkpoint (MIT base architecture, our weights at `b2://etzhayyim-models/rignet-anime-v0.<n>/`) — production fallback when Rigify produces a broken bind. Self-hosted invariant: no external rigging service (Mixamo / AccuRIG etc.) is called from this path. External APIs are train-only teacher signals — see `data/ghosthacker/TRAINING_PIPELINE.md`. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_auto_rig_humanoid.

blendshapePack.description: From extractFacialBlendshapes — uses head landmark to fit the Rigify meta-rig.

forceFallback.description: If true, skip Rigify and use the RigNet distill checkpoint directly (test path).

riggedGlbB64.description: Base64-encoded binary glTF with humanoid armature + weight-painted skin.
